prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / ads-marketing backdrop.
Create ONE SINGLE ULTRA-WIDE HORIZONTAL PANORAMIC ILLUSTRATION, target aspect ratio exactly 27:8 (6480 by 1920 layout pixels; six portrait 9:16 widths laid side by side). Three-and-three-eighths times wider than tall. It must be one continuous scene spanning the entire image, NOT a grid, NOT six panels, NOT six separate images. Use the widest high-resolution output possible with smooth crisp ink contours.

This is an app-market screenshot BACKGROUND for OneBeat / 同拍. The final design overlays six very large plain phone screens, so the backdrop must remain airy and subordinate. No phone/device frames, no screens, no UI, no cards, no typography at all.

Reference image 1 is the app's EXISTING SUNSET WALK ILLUSTRATION: use its relaxed walking/skating companionship, seaside promenade and distinctive Lilroll / Scooter identities, and confident ink linework. DO NOT copy any lettering, logo, cover layout, giant sun, or heavy orange/teal color dominance.
Reference image2 is the app's LILAC / PAPER / TEAL color family and soft cloud-shaped rhythm language ONLY, not a scene to duplicate. Reference image3 is the exact ONE-EYED CLOUD WALKER character identity, a blue small drummer with fluffy white cloud head and little wings. Reference image4 is exact mint TEAPOT WALKER identity, wearing a pink apron dress and boots. Preserve the original playful comic identities. Avoid inventing human characters.

ART DIRECTION AND PALETTE:
An elegant hand-inked editorial panorama, light and friendly, with clean flat print colors and very restrained internal hatching. Dominant uniform dusty lilac #C5B7EB sky/backdrop across the ENTIRE width, creamy white #FFF9EE strolling path and cloud highlights, ink #171B1F for selective contours, teal #29B5AE for sea and small shrubs, coral #FF7056 in a few tiny warm accents only. Keep lilac the main field. No grunge splatter, distressed texture, dark noisy halftone, deep blue night, neon glow or photorealism. Large simple readable shapes. Do not put a white sticker outline around every character.

CONTINUOUS SCENE:
One long, gently winding cream promenade runs from the far left edge to the far right edge through the lower half, with consistent horizon and scale. It starts at a calm seaside lookout on the left, passes a few sparse low plants and one bench in a relaxed small park at center, and reaches a tiny stylized street-corner silhouette with one lamp toward the far right. Sea ribbons, low hill silhouettes and a few sweeping cloud contours carry continuously across all six imagined page boundaries; absolutely no vertical seams or dividing lines. A sideways side-on panorama, not six repeated vanishing points. The environment is one world in the same light.

CHARACTERS:
Distribute a few small-to-medium original app characters naturally along the route in 2 or 3 loose groups rather than centering giant portraits. Lilroll (purple hoodie, lavender skin, lime skating helmet) and Scooter (acid yellow jacket, black helmet) move together in relaxed synchronized steps, arms hanging or in pockets, clear natural anatomy. The blue one-eyed cloud drummer rests at a small park spot tapping a little drum; the mint teapot walker joins the route elsewhere. No forced gripping/holding a huge phone. Hands should be simple, natural and correctly connected. Preserve correct limb count. Characters are part of the landscape, not isolated pasted stickers.

COMPOSITION FOR LATER PHONE OVERLAYS:
Keep the TOP roughly 30% mostly quiet lilac with only faint low-contrast cloud/hill shapes for future headlines. Put the main scene detail in a horizontally spreading band through the middle/lower portion, with plenty of negative space. Avoid placing every interesting thing at the exact center of the full panorama: distribute across the entire width. Leave some visible plants, cloud silhouettes and small scene objects near far left/right edges and between character groups. The long path and sea must visually connect across all crop boundaries. Calm uncluttered bottom edge and consistent framing.

Constraints: ONE full-width finished illustration. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no screenshot frames, no grid or page borders, no copied user interface, no empty phone-shaped holes. Opaque full background, not transparent.
